name: crossdb_unified_v1
description: Phase 13 跨数据库迁移验证统一问题集：同一组 24 个业务问题在 Database A（ecommerce.db）与 Database B（ecommerce_v2.db）上运行。gold_sql_a / gold_sql_b 分别为两库的 Gold SQL，语义等价但表名/字段名/口径不同。

items.question: 数据库里目前一共有多少个用户？
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members

items.question: 当前在售商品有多少个？
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE status = 'on_sale'
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE availability = 'in_stock'

items.question: 活跃用户有多少个？
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE status = 'active'
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE is_active = 1

items.question: 价格最高的10个商品的名称和售价是什么？
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 10
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT item_title, list_price FROM items ORDER BY list_price DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: 2026年8月的订单有多少笔？
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND order_date < '2026-09-01'
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_orders WHERE placed_on >= '2026-08-01' AND placed_on < '2026-09-01'

items.question: 平台总销售额是多少？（排除取消订单）
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ol.line_total), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_lines ol JOIN sales_orders so ON so.id = ol.sales_order_id WHERE so.order_state != 'voided'

items.question: 销售额最高的5个商品的名称和销售额是什么？（排除取消订单）
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT i.item_title, ROUND(SUM(ol.line_total), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_lines ol JOIN sales_orders so ON so.id = ol.sales_order_id JOIN items i ON i.id = ol.item_id WHERE so.order_state != 'voided' GROUP BY i.id ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5

items.question: 各类目的销售额排名是多少？（排除取消订单）
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total_sales DESC
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT d.dept_name, ROUND(SUM(ol.line_total), 2) AS total_sales FROM departments d JOIN items i ON i.dept_id = d.id JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.item_id = i.id JOIN sales_orders so ON so.id = ol.sales_order_id WHERE so.order_state != 'voided' GROUP BY d.id ORDER BY total_sales DESC

items.question: 各地区的销售额分别是多少？（排除取消订单）
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT o.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY total_sales DESC
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT m.city, ROUND(SUM(ol.line_total), 2) AS total_sales FROM sales_orders so JOIN members m ON m.id = so.member_id JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.sales_order_id = so.id WHERE so.order_state != 'voided' GROUP BY m.city ORDER BY total_sales DESC

items.question: 销售额最高的地区是哪个？（排除取消订单，输出地区与销售额）
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT o.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT m.city, ROUND(SUM(ol.line_total), 2) AS total_sales FROM sales_orders so JOIN members m ON m.id = so.member_id JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.sales_order_id = so.id WHERE so.order_state != 'voided' GROUP BY m.city ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: 客单价是多少？（排除取消订单，按订单实付金额平均）
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_amount FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_due), 2) AS avg_order_amount FROM sales_orders WHERE order_state != 'voided'

items.question: 总订单数是多少？
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_orders

items.question: 累计消费金额最高的3名用户的用户名和消费金额是什么？（排除取消订单，按实付金额）
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT u.username, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_spent FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 3
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT m.member_name, ROUND(SUM(so.payment_due), 2) AS total_spent FROM members m JOIN sales_orders so ON so.member_id = m.id WHERE so.order_state != 'voided' GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 3

items.question: 每月销售额趋势是怎样的？（排除取消订单）
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT substr(so.placed_on, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(ol.line_total), 2) AS total_sales FROM sales_orders so JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.sales_order_id = so.id WHERE so.order_state != 'voided' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

items.question: 每个类目下有多少个商品？
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(i.id) AS item_count FROM departments d LEFT JOIN items i ON i.dept_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id

items.question: 各订单状态的数量分布是怎样的？
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT order_state, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales_orders GROUP BY order_state

items.question: 2026年第二季度的销售额是多少？（排除取消订单）
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01'
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ol.line_total), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_lines ol JOIN sales_orders so ON so.id = ol.sales_order_id WHERE so.order_state != 'voided' AND so.placed_on >= '2026-04-01' AND so.placed_on < '2026-07-01'

items.question: 商品的平均售价是多少？
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT ROUND(AVG(list_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM items

items.question: 非取消订单的平均优惠金额是多少？
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT ROUND(AVG(discount_amount), 2) AS avg_discount FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT ROUND(AVG(coupon_deduction), 2) AS avg_discount FROM sales_orders WHERE order_state != 'voided'

items.question: 单条明细购买数量达到5件的订单明细有多少条？
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE quantity >= 5
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_lines WHERE qty >= 5

items.question: 从未下过单的用户有多少个？
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_without_orders FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id)
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT COUNT(*) AS members_without_orders FROM members m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_orders so WHERE so.member_id = m.id)

items.question: 销售额最高的类目名称是什么？（排除取消订单）
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT d.dept_name, ROUND(SUM(ol.line_total), 2) AS total_sales FROM departments d JOIN items i ON i.dept_id = d.id JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.item_id = i.id JOIN sales_orders so ON so.id = ol.sales_order_id WHERE so.order_state != 'voided' GROUP BY d.id ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: 2026年9月上半月（9月1日至9月15日）的订单有多少笔？
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND order_date < '2026-09-16'
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_orders WHERE placed_on >= '2026-09-01' AND placed_on < '2026-09-16'

items.question: 全体用户的平均累计消费金额是多少？（排除取消订单，按实付金额，先按用户汇总再求平均）
items.gold_sql_a: SELECT ROUND(AVG(user_total), 2) AS avg_lifetime_spend FROM (SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) AS user_total FROM orders o WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.user_id)
items.gold_sql_b: SELECT ROUND(AVG(member_total), 2) AS avg_lifetime_spend FROM (SELECT SUM(so.payment_due) AS member_total FROM sales_orders so WHERE so.order_state != 'voided' GROUP BY so.member_id)
